maya: Heads-up — seeing weird double-encoding when a tool call returns an array of objects in JSON mode. Node SDK + auth retry seems to wrap the array in a string on retry.

maya: Minimal repro (Node SDK):
```js
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  input: 'list items',
  json_mode: true,
  tools: [{ name: 'list_items', kind: 'tool' }]
});
// first call => res.output = [{id:1},{id:2}]
// after auth/retry => res.output = "[{\"id\":1},{\"id\":2}]"
```

maya: Anyone run into this? @kevin ? :thinking:

kevin: I can repro, saw similar in python but it returned an empty string instead of array on retry — seems like the retry wrapper is calling JSON.stringify on the tool result when it's treating it as 'primitive' due to missing content-type

ciara: throwing a quick hypothesis: our retry middleware serializes the tool return when 'streaming' flag is false. We changed behavior last week for a bug fix.

oliver: Repro steps + logs would help — can you attach request/response headers? Could be the auth refresh path which re-emits the cached response body incorrectly.

maya: attaching logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-22T14:01:02Z INFO tool-run: result = Array(2)
2026-03-22T14:01:02Z WARN auth: 401, refreshing token
2026-03-22T14:01:02Z INFO retry: replaying request, body = "[{\"id\":1},{\"id\":2}]"
```

kevin: ok looking. If it's the replay path we might be double-encoding in helper serializeForReplay. I'll open a tiny patch.

devex-bot: PR opened by kevin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1423 - 'fix: avoid stringify on array tool return during retry'

ciara: quick ask — can we add a unit test for arrays, objects, and streaming chunks? I can add Python parity tests.

maya: that would be great. For now workaround: wrap tool output in {data: ...} so it stays object typed on replay. Not ideal but helped us unblock onboarding samples.

oliver: thanks — tagging eng-ml for visibility. :thumbsup:

kevin: will merge after tests. ETA today EOD.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
